Contributor: qstep Discussion Comment No.: 1 Comment: Szia. Sima magánút ami egyébként járható, az access=private Az access=no azt jelenti hogy kifejezetten tilos bárkinek bemenni, mondjuk felújítás, átépítés, veszély miatt. Lásd wiki: https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tag:access%3Dprivate#Relation_to_access=no "Sometimes access=no is described as a stronger version of access=private. For example, a stretch of roadway may be closed with a “Road Closed” sign and barricades due to serious damage to a road or a long-term construction project. There may be a physical reason why no one would realistically be able to traverse the road. If applicable, also map any barriers that prevent anyone from entering or traversing the road. " Date: 2026-06-07T13:08:06+02:00
